typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SiteGroup as string,
		SiteName as string,
		DataHall as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		RackName as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		LowerCabinetU as integer,
		NlyteID as integer,
		RecordStatus as string,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		AssetName as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		MaterialID as integer,
		MaterialType as string,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		Manufacturer as string,
		Model as string,
		RUSize as double,
		LabPowerWatts as decimal(13,0),
		CreationDate as timestamp,
		LastUpdateDate as timestamp,
		RFCodeTag as string,
		Tag as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(IsBlankRow = iif((isNull(SiteGroup) || trim(SiteGroup) == ''), 1, 0)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn split(IsBlankRow == 0,IsBlankRow == 1, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Process,Ignore,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit1@Process split(Manufacturer == 'Corning' || Manufacturer == 'CommScope' || Manufacturer == 'Systimax',!((Manufacturer == 'Corning' || Manufacturer == 'CommScope' || Manufacturer == 'Systimax')), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case2,Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@Case2 sink(input(
		CreationDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MaterialID as integer,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		RUSize as double,
		WFGrid as string,
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		SiteGroup as string,
		LowerCabinetU as integer,
		AssetName as string,
		MaterialType as string,
		LabPowerWatts as double,
		DataHall as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		RackName as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		Manufacturer as string,
		Model as string,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		RecordStatus as string,
		LastUpdateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CreationDate,
		MaterialID,
		SiteName,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName,
		RUSize,
		WFGrid,
		RackNlyteID,
		OperationalStatus,
		SiteGroup,
		LowerCabinetU,
		AssetName,
		MaterialType,
		LabPowerWatts,
		DataHall,
		SerialNumber,
		RackName,
		NlyteID,
		Manufacturer,
		Model,
		MaterialSubtype,
		MaterialName,
		RecordStatus,
		LastUpdateDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
ConditionalSplit@Case1 sink(input(
		CreationDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MaterialID as integer,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		RUSize as double,
		WFGrid as string,
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		SiteGroup as string,
		LowerCabinetU as integer,
		AssetName as string,
		MaterialType as string,
		LabPowerWatts as double,
		DataHall as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		RackName as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		Manufacturer as string,
		Model as string,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		RecordStatus as string,
		LastUpdateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CreationDate,
		MaterialID,
		SiteName,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName,
		RUSize,
		WFGrid,
		RackNlyteID,
		OperationalStatus,
		SiteGroup,
		LowerCabinetU,
		AssetName,
		MaterialType,
		LabPowerWatts,
		DataHall,
		SerialNumber,
		RackName,
		NlyteID,
		Manufacturer,
		Model,
		MaterialSubtype,
		MaterialName,
		RecordStatus,
		LastUpdateDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
